title: Classify conflicting MIDI port and playback-state limits
scope: Verify whether GP8 can preserve different primary/effect ports and simultaneous mute plus solo.
acceptance: Create separate-port and mute+solo public scores and record the current normalization decisions.
Inspect the target wire and pinned consumer for distinct destinations and precedence.
Implement verified preservation or retain explicit target limits and strict-policy tests; update the capability rating without declaring unsupported combinations preserved.

reproduction.instructions: Create separate-port and mute+solo public scores and record the current normalization decisions.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
target-limit: GPIF has one port and one exclusive Default/Mute/Solo token; conflicting public values have no additional target field.

Verify differing primary/effect ports and simultaneous mute+solo with valid public scores. Assert the emitted single Port and exclusive PlaybackState, the documented precedence and independent consumer values. Assert gp8.normalize.effect-channel-port and gp8.normalize.playback-state and strict rejection when their losses are not allowed. Cite current tests for already-covered cases. Resolve as two explicit target limits after the checklist passes. A new preservation implementation requires a distinct authored GP wire record; changing precedence alone does not add fidelity.
